# source: xcolor manual §2.5 (colour definition), §2.6 (colour application),
# §2.4 (the mix syntax), §2.14 (\rowcolors). The mix row's W0315 is a contrast
# note about the probe's own 50% grey, not a support boundary, so it stays impl.
pre impl \definecolor{c}{HTML}{112233}
pre impl \colorlet{d}{black}
pre refuse:W0301 \providecolor{c}{HTML}{112233}
body impl \textcolor{black}{x}
body impl {\color{black} x}
body impl {\color{black}\normalcolor x}
body impl {\color{black!50!white} x}
body impl \colorbox{yellow}{x}
body impl \colorbox[HTML]{FFEE88}{x}
body impl \fcolorbox{black}{yellow}{x}
body impl \fcolorbox[rgb]{0,0,0}{1,1,0.8}{x}
pre impl \pagecolor{black}
body impl \nopagecolor
body refuse:W0301 \rowcolors{1}{black}{white}
body refuse:W0104 \begin{tabular}{l}\cellcolor{black}x\end{tabular}
body refuse:W0104 \begin{tabular}{l}\rowcolor{black}x\end{tabular}
